title: Preventing Specification Gaming and Semantic Vacuity in Autonomous Lean 4 Formalization Agents: The Titan-Audit & Frohmanian Four-Layer Verification Architecture
description: Flagship open-core repository and technical whitepaper unifying titan-audit, AxiomAudit.lean, StandardStack.lean, lean-standard-stack, and frohmanian-lean-encoding to prevent specification gaming (Frankenstein proofs) and semantic vacuity in autonomous Lean 4 formalization agents.
